title: Route Insights: embedding scorer telemetry & alerting blueprint
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a practical, route-scoped observability blueprint for the embeddings + rerank endpoints that ties latency, quality signals, and token/cycle cost back to routes and model variants. The goal is to enable engineers and PMs to: (1) quickly identify which customer routes are causing cost/longevity regressions; (2) triage quality vs latency trade-offs (example: larger embed model increases score_quality but also p95 latency); and (3) automate sensible alerts and escalation playbooks when a route crosses thresholds. This ticket focuses on instrumentation, dashboard layout, cost allocation metrics, alert definitions, and an initial runbook for on-call.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Per-route dashboards exist in Grafana with panels for embedding_generation_p95_ms, rerank_score_p95_ms, avg_batch_size, kv_cache_hit_ratio, and cost_per_1k_vectors. 2) Tracing spans implemented for embed.generate and rerank.score with route_id/model_id/batch_size tags. 3) Alert rules created: route_p95_latency > 300ms for 10m, route_error_rate > 1% for 5m, cost_per_route increase > 25% vs 7d baseline. 4) Playbook links + runbook added and verified in a tabletop exercise.
tasks: Instrument embed.generate and rerank.score spans with tags: route_id, route_name, model_id, model_variant, batch_size, seq_len, kv_cache_hit
Emit metrics: embedding.latency.ms, rerank.score.ms, embedding.rows_per_request, rerank.topk, embedding.kv_cache_hit_ratio, embedding.compute_cost_units
Add per-route cost attribution: tag metrics with route_id and model_variant; compute daily cost per route in billing job
Design Grafana dashboard template with panels for latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), error rates, avg batch size, cache heatmap, cost trend, and quality markers (eval pass rate)
Create Prometheus alert rules and Slack pager/ops-channel bindings; include automatic annotation to route dashboard when alert fires
Run tabletop: simulate a regression (higher-latency model rollout) and exercise runbook; record timings and gaps
Ship a small telemetry migration: sample traces at 20% for high-volume routes and 100% for canary routes; validate storage implications

2025-02-14 - Marcus Liu: Implemented initial spans in the Python SDK. Added tags route_id/model_variant/batch_size. Pushed branch feat/route-insights-instrumentation. Waiting on backend metric names to be finalized.
2025-02-18 - Priya Gomez (SRE): Reviewed draft alert rules. Recommended tightening the error_rate alert to 0.5% for high-traffic routes and adding suppression windows during deployments.
2025-02-21 - Marcus Liu: Heatmap panel for kv_cache_hit_ratio prototype is up; noted that hot-cold cache churn skews ratios for small routes. We should add route size buckets to the dashboard.
2025-02-25 - Elena Rossi (PM): Requested an additional quality panel that surfaces 'rerank_regression_rate' based on golden prompt evals. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-02-28 - Asha Patel: Tabletop scheduled for 2025-03-03. Updated runbook stub with initial steps: identify route, check model variant, compare p95 & cost deltas, rollback policy, notify customer success if impacted.

2025-03-01 - Marcus Liu: Merged tracing instrumentation for embed.generate into staging. Observed increase in trace volume; lowered sampling from 50% to 20% for production baseline. Performance impact measured: <1% CPU overhead.
release_notes: Adds per-route embedding and rerank telemetry and alerts. Initial rollout toggled behind feature flag `route_insights_v1`. Includes Grafana dashboard template and Prometheus alert rules. Backend introduces metric 'embedding.compute_cost_units' tagged by route_id and model_variant.
notes_on_cost_model: Cost attribution is computed from embedding.compute_cost_units (normalized compute-seconds per vector) and per-model CPU/GPU unit pricing. We bucket by route_id and aggregate daily. For privacy we expose 'cost_score_bucket' on dashboards (low/medium/high) instead of raw dollars by default.

Add console UI panel that surfaces 'cost_score_bucket' per route
